**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
The process of mapping a spiking neural network's graph structure onto physical or virtual processing elements while preserving temporal and spatial spike propagation constraints. Bridges TCC's topology-centric abstractions with iNEST's neuromorphic execution, ensuring efficient communication and minimal latency in spike-based computation.
